notes.content:
1. Changed the model of the main city weapon store

notes.title: 2023.5.7 update1
notes.content:
1. Reduce the floating attack of traps
2. Increase the number of shuffle privilege cards
3. Normal attack increases shield breaking value
4. The second weapon vending machine is moved to the main city

notes.title: 2023.5.6 UPDATE1
notes.content:
1. Improve the efficiency of obtaining experience and weapon medals
2. Increase the shield breaking value of counterattack
3. Adjust the wave of monsters in the second and third chapters
4. Increase the number of loot in the training room
5. Reduce the automatic locking angle of monsters
6. Reduce the damage-free ratio of shield monsters and reduce the value of shield bars

notes.title: 2023.5.5 update3
notes.content:
1. Change the attack of some monsters in Chapter 3/4 from knock-up to knock-back
2. Speed up the recovery of Nightmare Boss skills
3. Weaken the lightning element in the special effects of critical hits
4. Reduce spider attack power

notes.title: 2023.5.5 update
notes.content:
1. Fix the bugs of innovative loans and resurrection points
2. The monsters in the third and fourth chapters weaken the attack interval, attack power, mutated HP and shield
3. Added warning prompts for the skill range of scorpions and spiders in Chapter 3
4. The threat level of refuge 12 can be increased without being affected by the task, and the red equipment box can increase the map mark (11 difficulty can be refreshed)
5. Remove the negatives in the mutant props dropped by the BOSS
6. One-handed sword, ice and thunder fusion skills increase shield breaking and damage

notes.title: It's time to GO ROOOGUE!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865741/164510abc5369f0210e11eded1e650c6764106ce.png[/img]

Going Rogue: A Festival of Persistence is here!

As a member of this fascinating genre, [b]Metal Mutation[/b] also takes part in this event. We made some updates to the Demo a few days ago:

1. Add a beginners' guide
2. Optimize the character's stun locked time when getting hit
3. Reduce difficulty for some monsters
4. Reduce the mutation rate for monsters
5. Optimize the display of some skills

Apart from the above, we'll keep optimizing the sense of attack and striking. Welcome to try our Demo and give us more feedback during this festival!

Thank you all for your support! If you want to get instant access to our development progress and update information, welcome to join our [b]Discord channel: https://discord.gg/Xy9d557cdR[/b]

LET'S GO ROGUE!ːsteamhappyː
